title: The Master Appears
next_chapter_hook: Mr. Mo's final words before leaving exploded in Chen Ji's mind like thunder——'The death prophecy in Chapter 700 has been tampered with once.' What did this mean? A warning, or an even greater scheme?

text.content: Purple light surged like a tide from the edge of the horizon. That was no spiritual energy fluctuation, but something far more ancient and primeval, as if some existence that had slumbered for ten thousand years was awakening. In the air above the ruins, the Yuan Ying cultivators of three major forces changed expressions simultaneously—they had never seen such an omen in any records. Han Lie, the number one genius of Xuanwu Sect, felt his sword hum in his hand as he pointed it toward the purple light and shouted sternly: 'What lowly villain dares play tricks before us!' Yet his voice seemed so frail before the purple light, like an ant shouting before a giant wave.

Just as the three sides were sharpening their weapons and ready to clash at any moment, the void suddenly tore apart. A figure in blue robes stepped out from the rift, bearing no spiritual energy fluctuations whatsoever, yet causing everyone present to hold their breath. The person appeared middle-aged, with a gaunt face, but eyes as deep as two ancient wells, reflecting the rotation of sun, moon, and stars. Merely standing there, he seemed integrated with heaven and earth, impossible to ignore. Ling Yuan's pupils constricted sharply, his fingers hidden in his sleeves trembling slightly—he recognized this aura, or rather, he had read about it in some incomplete ancient text.

dialogue.content: 'Who are you, sir?' Ling Yuan suppressed the tumultuous waves in his heart and clasped his hands, saying, 'This is a conflict between our three major sects and the Demonic Path. If you're just passing by, please——' Before he finished speaking, that blue-robed man simply raised his hand slightly. In that instant, an invisible pressure like mountains collapsing pressed down on everyone present. Ling Yuan spat blood and flew backward; Han Lie's sword flew from his grasp and buried three feet into the ground; even Chen Ji watching from afar felt a tightness in his chest, as if an invisible giant hand had seized his heart.

text.content: The blue-robed man withdrew his hand, as if he had merely done something insignificant. His gaze passed over the crowd and finally landed on that unremarkable servant disciple in the corner. In that moment, Chen Ji's hairs stood on end—he felt his Tianji Record fragment vibrating violently, as if encountering some terrifying natural enemy. 'Chen Ji.' The man spoke, his voice calm yet carrying undeniable authority, 'Do you still remember your master?' These words exploded like thunder, Chen Ji's expression shifted slightly, and his mind raced: Mr. Mo, that mysterious existence existing as a remnant soul on the first page of the Tianji Record, actually possessed such power?

dialogue.content: Chen Ji收敛起所有情绪，躬身行礼，声音恭敬却带着一丝probing：'弟子陈机，见过前辈。前辈说笑了，弟子不过天青宗一介杂役，哪里有福分拜入前辈门下？'他的语气恰到好处地带着几分panicked，眼神却不卑不亢，直视着那双深邃的眼睛。墨先生嘴角微扬，似笑非笑地看着他：'三年来，你用天机录窥探天机不下百次，每次都说'弟子不敢'，倒是骗过了不少人。'此言一出，远处正在疗伤的凌渊猛地抬头，目光如电射向陈机。

text.content: Chen Ji心中一凛，迅速收敛起所有情绪fluctuation。他知道Mr. Mo这是在帮他撕开disguised——既然已经暴露，不如借此机会正大光明地站在台前。他直起身，trash人设瞬间褪去，取而代之的是一种历经沧桑的steady。'既然前辈已经说明，弟子便不再装了。'他环顾四周，看着三方势力或惊愕或忌惮或greedy的神情，心中sneered——这些人的嘴脸，他早就看透了。凌渊的眼中闪过一丝murderous，被陈机敏锐地捕捉到。很好，老狐狸终于沉不住气了。

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan强撑着站起身，抹去嘴角的血迹，阴恻恻地笑道：'原来天青宗的trash杂役竟是深藏不露的高人，倒是老夫看走眼了。'他顿了顿，目光在陈机和Mr. Mo之间来回扫视，'这位前辈，您口口声声说陈机是您的弟子，可我天青宗并无此人的拜师记录。莫非……前辈认错人了？'他的语气中带着probing与挑拨，显然是想挑起Mr. Mo与陈机之间的嫌隙。陈机心中暗叹，这老狐狸到死都在玩弄权术，却不知Mr. Mo的真实身份有多恐怖。

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan的话看似挑拨，实则在probingMr. Mo的底线。你该如何应对？

choices.description: 不急着辩解，让Mr. Mo自己证明身份。正好借机观察Mr. Mo的底线和态度。
choices.visible_cost: 可能让Ling Yuan进一步挑拨成功
choices.visible_reward: 看清Mr. Mo的真实态度和实力
choices.risk_hint: Mr. Mo可能不喜欢被人利用来证明什么

text.content: 陈机后退一步，做出一副无辜受害者的姿态，眼观鼻鼻观心，仿佛这一切都与他无关。Mr. Mo看了他一眼，眼中闪过一丝approving——这小子倒是沉得住气。Ling Yuan见状，以为自己挑拨成功，正要继续开口，却被Mr. Mo一个眼神钉在原地动弹不得。'天青宗？'Mr. Mo淡淡道，'老夫与你天青宗的渊源，可比你想象的要深得多。'

choices.description: 不惯着Ling Yuan，直接用言语戳穿他的险恶用心，顺便probingMr. Mo的立场。
choices.visible_reward: 打击Ling Yuan气焰，在Mr. Mo面前展示能力
choices.risk_hint: edge太露可能引起Mr. Mo不满

text.content: Chen Jisneered一声，不退反进，目光直视Ling Yuan：'Ling掌门好大的威风，弟子不过是被人揭穿身份，您就迫不及待地想要挑拨离间？'他的声音不高，却清晰地传入每个人耳中，'方才前辈出手，您连一招都接不下，如今却还有心思玩弄这些小手段？弟子倒想请教，您这般urgent地想要我与前辈反目，究竟是何居心？'Ling Yuan脸色铁青，却被陈机这番话堵得说不出话来。

Mr. Mo负手而立，目光扫过在场众人，最后落回陈机身上。他的眼神中带着一种complex的神情——既是gratified，又是忧虑。'Tianji Record选中之人，果然不凡。'他slowly开口，'你可知道，Tianji Record并非寻常功法，而是上古天机阁的核心传承？'此言一出，全场哗然。天机阁，那是传说中能够窥探天机、预知祸福的mysterious势力，早在万年前就已覆灭。Ling Yuan的眼中闪过一丝greedy，却又迅速敛去——他知道，有些东西不是他能觊觎的。
陈机心中一凛，天机录的来历他并非毫不知情，但从Mr. Mo口中亲耳听到，却是另一番感受。他想起残页上那些模糊的纹路，想起每次使用后消耗的fate，想起Mr. Mo作为残魂守护者存在的原因——一切似乎都在指向一个更大的棋局。'前辈的意思是……'他斟酌着措辞，'天机阁的覆灭，并非偶然？'Mr. Mo没有直接回答，只是从袖中取出一枚古朴的玉佩，那玉佩通体漆黑，上面刻着繁复的纹路，散发着幽幽的光芒。

dialogue.content: '此物名为'逆天佩'，可屏蔽天道意志的观测。'Mr. Mo将玉佩递向陈机，'你身怀天机录，一举一动都在天道的注视之下。这枚玉佩虽只能遮挡三日，却足以让你摆脱某些……不必要的麻烦。'陈机看着那枚玉佩，心中却没有半分欣喜。他太了解Mr. Mo了——这个以残魂形态存在的mysterious存在，每次给予他帮助都并非无偿。'前辈想要弟子做什么？'他直接问道。Mr. Mo笑了，笑容中带着几分admiring：'聪明。'

choice.prompt: The heaven-defying pendant gifted by Mo Xiansheng seems like a lifeline, but there's no such thing as a free lunch in this world. How will you respond?

choices.text: Take it first, then figure things out
choices.description: A free benefit that's given should be taken; as for what comes after, deal with it when the time comes.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the Heaven-Defying Pendant, temporarily escaping Heavenly Observation
choices.risk_hint: Debts of favor are the hardest to repay, especially favors from Mo Xiansheng

text.content: Chen Ji did not hesitate long before reaching out and accepting the Heaven-Defying Pendant. The jade pendant was cold to the touch, and a strange force instantly enveloped his entire body, as if he were置身于 an invisible barrier. The Tianji Record Fragment's trembling also calmed down, becoming docile and obedient. "Thank you, Senior." He tucked the pendant into his chest, raising his eyes to look at Mo Xiansheng, "May I know what instructions the Senior has for me?" Mo Xiansheng shook his head: "It's not time yet. When you reach Volume Seven, you will understand." His tone was calm, yet it caused Chen Ji to feel an inexplicable chill. Volume Seven... that meant there was still a long road ahead.

choices.description: Don't rush to accept, clarify things first. When borrowing, one must understand clearly; can't blindly enter a game.
choices.visible_reward: Figure out Mo Xiansheng's intentions so as not to passively enter the game
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng might not appreciate being scrutinized like this

text.content: Chen Ji did not reach out his hand, but stared directly into Mo Xiansheng's eyes: "Senior's generous gift, this disciple is unworthy. Please clarify what is the price of this Heaven-Defying Pendant?" Mo Xiansheng was slightly stunned, then burst into laughter: "Good, good, good!" He said three goods in succession, "Indeed, I was not mistaken about you." The laughter stopped, and his expression turned serious, "The price? When you complete the seven-volume goal, I will tell you then." He paused, "But there is one thing that must be said now—the death prophecy in Chapter Seven Hundred has been tampered with once." These words poured like cold water over Chen Ji's head, freezing him on the spot.

"Death prophecy. Chapter Seven Hundred. Chen Ji's mind raced—according to the patterns of the Tianji Record, every hundred chapters brings a critical turning point, and Chapter Seven Hundred was his destined death calamity. He had always believed that was the judgment of Heavenly Dao's will, his inescapable fate. But now Mo Xiansheng told him that prophecy had been tampered with? What did that mean? Someone wanted him dead? Or was there a deeper conspiracy? Countless possibilities flashed through his mind, yet there were no answers. In the distance, Ling Yuan watched this scene, his eyes flickering with complex light, as if calculating something.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji!" Ling Yuan suddenly spoke, his voice carrying a hint of urgency, "This Elder's words, you must consider carefully. A being of unknown origin, giving you a treasure that can shield from heavenly secrets, and telling you your destined death calamity has been tampered with—doesn't this seem suspicious?" His tone sounded like he was looking out for Chen Ji, yet his eyes concealed malicious gloating. Chen Ji coldly smiled in his heart, the old fox was playing the trick of sowing discord again. But he had to admit, Ling Yuan's words did indeed poke at his doubts. Was Mo Xiansheng friend or foe? The answer to this question, he could not determine for now.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng seemed utterly indifferent to Ling Yuan's provocation, merely glancing at him indifferently. That glance held no emotion whatsoever, yet it made Ling Yuan feel as if he had fallen into an icy abyss, as though some terrifying existence had set its sights on him. "The matter between this old man and Chen Ji does not concern you." Mo Xiansheng withdrew his gaze, saying to Chen Ji, "Time is running short, that fourth faction will arrive soon. This place is not safe to linger, come with me." With that, he raised his hand and slashed through the void, tearing open a crack. Chen Ji glanced at Ling Yuan, his gaze terrifyingly calm: "Sect Master Ling's guidance, this disciple will remember." With that, he followed Mo Xiansheng into the crack and vanished before everyone's eyes.

Within the spatial rift, Chen Ji felt the world spinning, the sensation of empty ground beneath his feet making him extremely uncomfortable. When he opened his eyes again, he found himself in a desolate mountain valley. Silence reigned all around, only the howling mountain wind sweeping past, bringing waves of chill. Mo Xiansheng stood not far away, his back turned to Chen Ji, gazing at the swirling purple clouds in the distance. "Senior." Chen Ji spoke up, "What exactly is that fourth faction?" Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment before slowly saying: "That is... the remnant grudge entity after the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion's destruction. Their target is not the ruins, but you." Chen Ji's heart tightened. Grudge entity? The Heavenly Secrets Pavilion's grudge? How much karma was involved in all this?

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng turned around, his gaze deep and profound as he looked at Chen Ji: "You should have already guessed that the Tianji Record is one of the pieces placed in this world by Heavenly Dao's will." Chen Ji nodded, he had long suspected the Tianji Record's origin was unusual. "But what you don't know is that the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion's destruction was the handiwork of Heavenly Dao's will." Mo Xiansheng's voice was calm, yet it carried an indescribable sorrow, "The Heavenly Secrets Pavilion had mastered too many secrets that should not have been mastered, and Heavenly Dao would not permit their existence. And now, those remnant grudges want revenge—their target is to destroy the inheritor of the Tianji Record." Chen Ji clenched his fists, fate, it truly never stood on his side.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng seemed to see through his thoughts, saying calmly: "But you are different from all previous Tianji Record inheritors." He stretched out a finger and pointed at Chen Ji's brow center, "Those inheritors only knew how to submit to fate, but you... are rebelling against heaven to change your fate. This is your greatest advantage, and the thing Heavenly Dao's will fears most about you." Chen Ji was slightly shaken in his heart. Submit to fate? Rebel against heaven to change fate? He had never imagined his actions would have such significance in Mo Xiansheng's eyes. "Why does Senior help me?" He asked the doubt in his heart, "You exist in the Tianji Record as a remnant soul, what benefit could you possibly gain?" Mo Xiansheng was silent for a long time, so long that Chen Ji thought he wouldn't answer.

dialogue.content: "Because you are the last one." Mo Xiansheng finally spoke, his voice carrying a trace of exhaustion, "The Tianji Record fragments are about to become complete, and you are the final inheritor. When you complete the eight-volume goal, the Tianji Record will be completely unsealed, and then..." He didn't finish, but Chen Ji read the unsaid meaning in his eyes. What would happen then? Would he soar to greatness, or fall into eternal damnation? Mo Xiansheng's form began to grow translucent, clearly this projection couldn't be sustained much longer. "Senior!" Chen Ji stepped forward, but saw Mo Xiansheng wave his hand. "Remember, the prophecy of Chapter Seven Hundred has only been tampered with once. The true variable lies in your hands."

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's form completely dissipated, leaving only a voice echoing in the mountain valley: "Keep in mind, the Heaven-Defying Pendant can only be used three times, each time for three days. Exceeding this will render it invalid. Additionally, that grudge entity is not invincible—it fears the aura of the Tianji Record, but your cultivation is too low, you cannot control it in a short time. Therefore—" The voice cut off abruptly, as if forcibly severed by some force. Chen Ji stood in the mountain valley, clutching the Heaven-Defying Pendant in his hand, his mood complicated. This trip brought great gains, but also drew greater troubles. The Heavenly Secrets Pavilion's grudge, Heavenly Dao's watchful gaze, and that tampered death prophecy... everything told him that his path was far more dangerous than he had imagined.

Mountain winds howled, disheveling Chen Ji's hair. He raised his head to gaze at the distant swirling purple clouds—the fourth faction, the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion's remnant grudge entity, was approaching the ruins. He didn't know if Ling Yuan and the others could hold them off, but one thing was clear to him: this chess game was far from its conclusion. He gripped the Heaven-Defying Pendant tightly, then turned and stepped into the night. The death prophecy of Chapter Seven Hundred had been tampered with... what did that mean? Someone wanted to save him, or someone wanted to kill him? Regardless, this answer, he must find out himself. The Tianji Record in his arms faintly radiated warmth, as if responding to his determination. And in the purple clouds far toward the ruins, something seemed to be watching him.
